title: HomeFlood Rate Rule: Loss-History Credit on a Re-Rated Term Premium
content:
**Rule.** The loss-history credit of a HomeFlood Private Residential Flood Policies re-rated term premium, worked out when an Elevation Certificate review is completed, rests on two things: claim payments net of voided payments, by date of loss, and how long Tidemark has insured the address.

**Where the payments are looked for.** Payments are counted both under this HomeFlood policy and under the customer's NFIP record for the address. That record is a policy of the NFIP Dwelling Form Flood Policies (Write Your Own), and its claim payments and voided claim payments are read from its claim file.

**The re-rating date.** Every window and length of time this credit counts runs to the re-rating date. The re-rating date is the day the certificate review is completed and recorded. It is neither the date Tidemark received the certificate nor the term start.

**The NFIP record.** The customer's NFIP record for the address is the Tidemark NFIP Dwelling Form policy this HomeFlood policy replaced — the one whose policy number is the policy's replaced NFIP policy number. A HomeFlood policy that replaced no NFIP policy has no NFIP record.

**How long Tidemark has insured the address.** This is counted in whole calendar months to the re-rating date from the original effective date of the NFIP record or, when there is no NFIP record, from this HomeFlood policy's effective date.

**The ladder.**

| Tier of the credit | Net claim payments, by date of loss | Tidemark has insured the address for | Credit |
|---|---|---|---|
| longer loss-free record | total zero under this policy **and** zero under the NFIP record, for losses dated fewer than 120 whole months before the re-rating date | at least 120 whole months | 8 percent |
| shorter loss-free record (the longer condition not met) | total zero under this policy **and** zero under the NFIP record, for losses dated fewer than 36 whole months (the tier's claims-free period of 3 years times 12) before the re-rating date | at least 36 whole months | the tier's claims-free credit percent, 5 percent |
| otherwise | — | — | no loss-history credit |

A count of whole calendar months runs from the earlier date to the later one; the last month is not counted when the later date's day of the month falls before the earlier date's day of the month. A loss is counted in a window when the whole months from its date of loss to the re-rating date are fewer than the window's length. A claim whose payments have all been voided nets to zero.

**Form of the credit.** The credit is a percent by which the re-rated term premium is reduced.

**How credits combine.** The credits of the re-rated term premium are added to one another, never multiplied. Their sum is capped at the tier's ceiling on combined credits, 15 percent. The factored amount is reduced once by that capped sum, before the loss-of-use charge is added.

## Hypothetical cases

| Net payments, losses under 120 months old | Net payments, losses under 36 months old | Months insured | Credit |
|---|---|---|---|
| 0 under both | 0 under both | 150 | 8 percent |
| 0 under both | 0 under both | 119 | 5 percent |
| 4,200.00 on the NFIP record (loss 70 months old) | 0 under both | 150 | 5 percent |
| 0 under both | 0 under both | 35 | none |
| 1,800.00 on this policy (loss 20 months old) | 1,800.00 | 150 | none |
